name: query_knowledge
description: Search the knowledge base for information about the codebase, documentation, or work history. Use this when someone asks a technical question, wants to know about code, or asks about recent work.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query - rephrase the user's question as a clear search query

name: query_git_history
description: Search recent git history for information about what was done recently. Use this when someone asks 'what did you do yesterday', 'what changed recently', 'summarize recent work', or similar questions about development activity.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query about recent development activity

name: query_code
description: Search the codebase for specific code, functions, classes, or technical implementation details. Use this when someone asks about how something is implemented, what a function does, or wants code details.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query about code or implementation

name: query_docs
description: Search project documentation for architecture, design decisions, guides, and reference information. Use this when someone asks about project documentation, architecture, or design decisions.

name: list_specialists
description: List available specialist agents that the user can switch to for deeper domain expertise. Call this when the user asks what specialists are available or when you want to suggest a handoff.
